# Copilot Instructions

## Repository Purpose

This is a content-only repository — a curated collection of architectural interview questions and their answers. There is no source code, build system, or test suite.

## Content Conventions

- Each entry should include both a **question** and a **thorough answer**.
- Questions should cover software architecture topics (e.g., system design, design patterns, scalability, microservices, distributed systems, cloud architecture, trade-offs).
- Answers should be practical and interview-appropriate — concise enough to deliver verbally, but complete enough to demonstrate depth.
- Avoid duplicating questions already present in the file.

## Contributing Content

When adding new Q&A entries, follow the structure already established in the README (or any dedicated content files if added later). Keep formatting consistent with existing entries.
